phoenix.//: Not in the launcher: the app carries the Slack account (accounts/wizard.html, the template in public/accounts, the service). A connector package of Phoenix's own, installed from the catalog's Connections (docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 7); its sign-in needs Phoenix's Slack app and the token relay, and its reading speed the Slack Marketplace listing (docs/DEVELOPER-APPS.md).
